resources.string: What you send to this site, and what it sends back, can\'t be read or changed on the way.
Others on the network can see or change this page. Don\'t enter passwords or payment details here.
This page comes from a server running on this phone, so it doesn\'t cross the network on its way here.
This is an onion service. The connection is encrypted all the way to it through Tor, and its address is its own key, so others on the network can\'t see or change this page.
This page comes from a peer-to-peer network, not from one website\'s server, so there is no certificate to show.
This page comes from one server, %1$s, not from the peer-to-peer network. Its content isn\'t checked against the page\'s CID, so that server could have changed it.

This page came from the peer-to-peer network through this phone\'s IPFS node, which checked it against the page\'s CID. IPFS now goes through one server, %1$s, so what the page loads from here on comes from that server and isn\'t checked.
That only covers where the name points. The page itself came through %1$s and wasn\'t checked.
This page is read from a smart contract on a blockchain, not from one website\'s server, so there is no certificate to show.
This repository comes from the Radicle node on this phone, which gets it from peers, not from one website\'s server, so there is no certificate to show.
Nothing from this site is on screen, so there is no connection to describe.
Its cookies and the data it stored on this phone are removed, so you\'ll be signed out of it. The page reloads.
Its cookies and the data it stored in this private session are removed, so you\'ll be signed out of it. The page reloads.
Shared by every page opened through %1$s
Every page opened through this gateway shares these cookies and this stored data, so it\'s removed for all of them, not only this one. The page reloads.
Every page opened through this gateway in this private session shares these cookies and this stored data, so it\'s removed for all of them, not only this one. The page reloads.
